name: send_message
title: Reply to a customer
description:
Send a message to the customer as the signed-in person, on the conversation's own number or mailbox. It goes straight
away and cannot be taken back. Writing into a conversation the AI is running takes it over until `resume_ai`.
The same text within 10 minutes is sent once: a repeat answers
`already_sent`, or `in_progress` while the first has not finished. `sent_unfinished`: the customer got it but stopping
the AI failed, so repeat the call to finish.

body.description: The message, exactly as the customer should get it.
